    // How far the worst sample stands out from the typical one: the maximum
    // error over the RMS error. One means perfectly uniform residuals, large
    // values indicate an outlier. Precondition: RootMeanSquareError is
    // non-zero.
    OutlierRatio(self: FitQuality): Number
        => self.MaximumError / self.RootMeanSquareError;
